section_summary.extract_value: This Limitations section emphasizes that the present study is cross-sectional and cannot determine causation, notes potential biases from recruitment via a crowdsourcing marketplace (limiting representativeness of the wider US population), and states the sample's mean BMI fell in the overweight category. It also raises concerns about measurement limits for sexual liberalism and positive body image measures (e.g., BI-AAQ, BASES-AP) and notes that positive body image accounted for a relatively small amount of variance in sexual outcomes.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key supporting sentences include: “The main limitation of the present work concerns its crosssectional nature.”; “Our method of recruitment may have also introduced unintentional biases. Although crowdsourcing marketplace samples are known to be more demographically-diverse than standard Internet samples...”; “In particular, it should be noted that the mean BMI of our sample fell in the overweight category...”; and passages describing measurement limitations of BI-AAQ and BASES-AP.
